result:
I fixed all three problems. The existing test suite passes (617 tests), but I added no new tests for these cases.

1. **Switching off didn't stick** (`src/server/repositories/webhook-repository.ts`): the update only wrote the on/off setting when it was on, so "off" was silently dropped. It now saves both on and off. New events already skip switched-off endpoints, so this also stops them being queued while an endpoint is off.
2. **Old queued events still went out** (`src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts`): the delivery run now marks a queued delivery as failed if its endpoint is switched off, as it already did when the endpoint no longer exists. Deliveries to endpoints that are on still go out, and the delivered and failed counts work as before.
3. **Allowance check ignored switched-off endpoints** (`src/server/services/webhook-service.ts`): creating an endpoint now counts every endpoint in the workspace, on or off. A workspace that has reached its plan's limit is now refused even if some endpoints are switched off.
